source.author: stat
source.text: vix reserata dies, et iam rate celsus Iason ire iubet, primoque ferit dux verbere pontum.
source.text_original: vix reserata dies, et iam rate celsus Iason / ire iubet, primoque ferit dux verbere pontum.
source.text_english: Scarcely had day been opened, and already lofty Jason orders the raft to go, and the leader strikes the sea with the first stroke.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: emicuit reserata dies caelumque resolvit arcus et in summos redierunt nubila montes.
reuse.text_original: emicuit reserata dies caelumque resolvit / arcus et in summos redierunt nubila montes.
reuse.text_english: Day broke, the heavens were unbarred, and the rainbow dissolved, and the clouds returned to the highest mountains.
